author: bots-coordinator
pitfalls: ggml_backend_load_all_from_path(<dir with libs>) MUST run before llama_model_load_from_file, otherwise it returns NULL ('no backends are loaded')
llama_context_params.kv_unified MUST be true: without it each sequence gets its own KV stream and llama_memory_seq_cp across streams hits GGML_ASSERT(is_full) and kills the process
llama_get_logits_ith(ctx, i) takes the TOKEN INDEX WITHIN THE BATCH, not the order of the logits flags
notes: Two branches (different questions) were decoded in ONE llama_batch: tokens of both suffixes in the same batch, each with its own seq_id, logits flag only on the last token of each branch.
Positions: both branches start at len(prefix) — cross-sequence positions may coincide.
Equivalence test: the same question decoded sequentially on a fresh context produced probabilities identical to the fork readout (max |delta| = 0.00e+00).
